root_cause: Phase 4.1 index misalignment bug: in Step 3, `trunc_indices = trunc_meta_df.index.values` indexed rows 0..N-1 of `X_val` (which represented only the first engine at cycles 75..75+N), while `actual_rul` contained the true cutoff targets across all engines. This created severe row-level target mismatch in the primary benchmark (45-88 cycles). In contrast, the cap/window tables (15-20 cycles) evaluated predictions on rows 0..N-1 against `y_val[0..N-1]`, which evaluated a single engine rather than all cutoff checkpoints. The recomputed value correctly evaluates feature vectors drawn directly from each engine's cutoff checkpoint against its own positive RUL target.
resolution: Corrected matrix extraction via `prepare_truncation_matrices` yields verified true MAE 15.15.
